head: SongShift app update: browse your music library and edit playlists
dek: SongShift 7.0, the iPhone app for moving playlists between music services, adds a library tab where you browse your connected services, add songs to playlists and edit playlist names and descriptions. The app is free to download.
details: It works with Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube, Tidal, Deezer, SoundCloud, Pandora, Qobuz and others; moving music into Apple Music needs an Apple Music subscription. Version 7 also adds new Siri and Shortcuts actions, refreshed widgets, iPhone Duo support and steadier transfers that recover after interruptions. Playlist sharing moved to a separate app, SongMix.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, out now
means: If you're switching from one music app to another, you can now tidy your playlists inside SongShift instead of opening each service.
todo: Update SongShift from the App Store and check the new library tab; review the song matches before you start a transfer.
